main_text.l: In principio temporis Deus creauit cœlum &
& 2. Fuit autem istud principium veris: quia
hæc est naturalissima & perfectissima anni ratio, ut
incipiat à vere. Quæ etiam causa est,
quòd Deus annum sacrum inchoauit à vere,
politi-cum ab autumno. Sanè perfectissimam anni
rationem in sacris obtinuisse nemini debet
622. | Enoch, filius Iared, nascitur. Gen.5.v.18. Hic fuit
987. | Enoch assumitur viuus in cœlum. Gen.5.v.24.25.
1056. | Noah, decimus ab Adam, nascitur ex Lamecho.

page.notes: Line numbers 5 to 35 in the right margin are kept as margin notes beside the lines they stand against. A small mark after "esse" at the right margin is not text and is left out. Column rules and the "An.M." labels are layout only. Text is clear throughout; no illegible words. Long s is written as s, so "fuit se-ptimus" appears with a printed hyphen. Spelling of u/v and i/j normalised per rule 5. Printed "creauit", "inchoauit" and "vniuersum" are normalised to "creavit", "inchoavit" and "universum" in the text as per the u/v rule; "exercitū" keeps the macron.
